title: Margaret Lei
text: Hello, I am Margaret. I am a language enthusiast in Canada, with over 5 years of experience in English language assessment. Now I am currently studying to break into the tech industry via computational linguistics or natural language processing.

title: About
text: I was born and raised in British Columbia, Canada. I graduated with a BA in Linguistics and explored many careers applying linguistics, such as editing and ESL teaching. Shortly after graduation, I started working at an assessment company on the team developing content for English proficiency tests.
